narrative: The NSA's MCP security-design guidance puts a named federal-security authority on record about agentic-AI cyber risk - the inverted client-server pattern, unverified task propagation, arbitrary-code-execution - the same week researchers filed 67 MCP CVEs and disclosed the Ollama Bleeding Llama flaw, advancing the designation-and-benchmarking scaffolding the thesis says federal cyber bodies build before it hardens into a procurement gate.
remaining_gap: The guidance is design advice, not a contracting instrument; no FAR amendment, acquisition rule, solicitation clause, or covered-vendor cyber attestation on a federal award has appeared yet.
